note: anchor sets used in this work. The Thai set is the deployed one and is ALSO the set that produced every cross-domain number reported in the paper (runs/e6_ood/run_e6.sh does not set ANCHORS, so the default Thai set applies). The CCPD and Open Images sets below were fitted by k-means (scripts/fit_anchors.py) for the supplementary anchor experiment of Section VI.E; only the Open Images variant of that experiment was completed. Format: [w, h] in grid cells at 320x320 input.
how_to_use: export ANCHORS="11.7,2.4;16.1,3.1;22.0,3.9" before scripts/y_a_train.py, scripts/finetune_public.py or scripts/y_b_qt.py; unset = Thai deployed set
